title: What the Ruins Hold
summary: Titanite, the three void items, Embers, accessories

blocks.text: Goal: take your first relic out of a Hoanna ruin chest. The chests at the top of ruined-town towers and in the exit rooms of old catacombs (see [[hoanna/ruins]]) share the same loot, drawn 6 to 17 times per chest.

rows: Void Plate, Void Core, MRU Reactor
about 0.2 each (one of each per ~5 chests)
Mid-game materials (Magical Essence, Magical Ingot, Magical Water, Magic Fortified Plating, the four purified alloys)

blocks.text: Void Cores and MRU Reactors only come from these chests: they cannot be mined or crafted. Void Plates can also be pressed yourself (see [[hoanna/void_plating]]). For more, find more towns and catacombs.

items: Void Plate, Void Core, MRU Reactor: put one in the Magician Table's upgrade slot for <t>×6</t>, <t>×7.5</t> or <t>×10</t> speed (see [[crafting/magician_table]]).
Embers: no use yet. Keep them.

items.text: Mystical Accessory: a random necklace, belt or ring with three random MRU resistances, one of them against Hoanna radiation (see [[baubles/mystical_accessory]]).

blocks.text: The {item:essentialcraft5:concrete}, {item:essentialcraft5:levitator} (buried right under each corner of a house; you usually cannot see it, so dig out the block under a corner) and {item:essentialcraft5:spreader} (the small glowing post) in towns can be mined with a pickaxe and taken home as decoration. They have no recipes; towns are the only source.

blocks.title: Done when
blocks.text: You carry any relic: Titanite, one of the three void items, an Ember or a Mystical Accessory.

Embers are the old fires of Hoanna, each still holding a little warmth of that world. The old Chinese translation called them "ashes", and it also mistranslated the Void Plate and Void Core as a "blank plate" and an "invalid core".

title: {item:essentialcraft5:void_stone}
summary: The toughest building block; casing and coil base

blocks.text: Goal: turn the Titanite from the ruins into {item:essentialcraft5:void_stone}, the toughest building block of this mod and the material for the Void Plate on the next page.

You need: 4 {item:essentialcraft5:titanite} and 1 {item:essentialcraft5:twinkling_titanite} (see [[hoanna/relics]]), plus 4 {item:essentialcraft5:obsidian_plate} (for Void Stone) or 4 {item:essentialcraft5:fortified_frame} (for Void Glass).
One craft gives 16 Void Stone or 32 Void Glass; 6 Void Stone (two rows of three) make 16 Void Fences.

rows: needs a pickaxe; always drops white
drops even when broken by hand, but that takes about 12 seconds; a pickaxe is much faster (about 1.5 seconds with diamond); translucent dark purple; mobs do not spawn on it
needs a pickaxe; connects to other stone fences

blocks.text: Right-click Void Stone or Void Glass with a dye to recolor it: the dye colors the veins on its face, while the dark stone or glass underneath stays as it is. The dye is not used up. Sneak-right-click to dye the same blocks around it too (blocks where you are not allowed to build, such as someone else's claim, are skipped).

items: Blocking MRU: between you and an MRU cluster, matrix damage reaches you with a chance of <t>1/18</t> through Void Stone and <t>1/15</t> through Void Glass (default settings), better than plating (see [[alloys/plating]]).
Void Stone and Void Glass count as casing for the [[enrichment/controller]]; Void Stone works as a [[tesla/mru_coil]] base.
The Magician Table presses it into a Void Plate (next page).
The Magical Chisel carves it into patterned blocks (see [[decorations/patterns]]).

blocks.text: The floors and beams of modern shafts (see [[hoanna/ruins]]) are made of Void Stone. Bring a pickaxe.

blocks.title: Done when
blocks.text: You have Void Stone in your inventory.

title: {item:essentialcraft5:void_plating}
summary: Pressed from Void Stone; upgrades and gun parts

blocks.text: Goal: press {item:essentialcraft5:void_stone} into a {item:essentialcraft5:void_plating} on the Magician Table. Chests have them too, but making your own is far more reliable.

items: Put Void Stone in the center slot of the Magician Table and leave the four corners empty.
Feed the table MRU (see [[crafting/magician_table]]); one plate takes <t>1000</t> MRU.
Take the plate from the output slot on the right.

rows: Void Plates in both S slots: <t>12</t>× zoom (see [[guns/sniper]])

blocks.text: Most of the stronger machines and gear later on need Void Plates, so it pays to keep a stack.

blocks.title: Done when
blocks.text: You have a Void Plate in your inventory.
